whatThisIs: Paths under evidence/ that carry host paths and are NOT redacted, each with the reason. An entry is not a pardon: the gate re-checks every condition below on every run, and an entry that stops being true turns the gate red.
closure: presence must be one of "expected" (the default) or "machine-local"

nothing under the path may be tracked by git — the moment it is `git add`ed the exception fails, because the hygiene obligation is about what enters history. This condition is answered from the git index, so it still holds on a checkout that does not have the file, and it is the condition the whole exception turns on
presence "expected": the path must exist — a stale entry is red, so the list cannot outlive its reason
presence "machine-local": absence is not a failure, because the material is by design never committed and so is absent in every other checkout. This is the only condition the mode exempts
whenever the path IS present: at least one file under it must still carry a host path, whatever the presence mode — an exception whose reason has evaporated is red
whyPresenceExists: v1 required existence unconditionally, which made the list jointly unsatisfiable with the untracked condition on any fresh checkout: an untracked path is absent there by definition. The closing clean-checkout run that the delivery-cadence convention makes the single mandatory gate therefore could not go green while any entry was listed, and nobody hit it because the gate had only ever been run in a working tree that had the material (TCRN-AOS-INIT-003). The fix is a declared exemption for one condition, not a loosening of the rule for everyone.

entries.reason: CONF-007 的侦察与验证子代理原始输出,未入库的在途工作材料而非已归档证物。它们是「代理当时说了什么」的记录,改写其字节等于改写记录本身,而它们没有 git 基线可供回滚;因此不脱敏、也不入库。链上零引用(对活链 grep 该路径无命中),这是它与同目录下两件被链引用证物的实质区别。若要归档,先脱敏再 git add——add 的那一刻本条例外即失效转红。
